title: Horse and rider thrown into the sea
english: [[Let us sing to the Lord: horse and rider he has thrown into the sea >> Bible:Exodus 15:1]]. Those who chase us are “horses”; they carry riders — demonic powers or reigning vices. Christ sends a [[cavalry of salvation >> Bible:Habakkuk 3:8]]. Know God as yours and glorify him; know him as Father and exalt him — [[that all may honor the Son as they honor the Father >> Bible:John 5:23]].
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Helper and protector become my salvation
english: [[He has become my helper and protector for salvation; the Lord is his name >> Bible:Exodus 15:2-3]]. Leaving Egypt is not enough; battle still needs a helper. This is the church’s song after the baptismal sea.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Pharaoh’s chariots sunk like lead
english: [[Pharaoh’s chariots and army he cast into the sea; his chosen captains sank in the Red Sea >> Bible:Exodus 15:4]]. The deeps covered them; they went down [[like lead in mighty waters >> Bible:Exodus 15:10]]. When the people pass through, unseen enemies sink.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Right hand glorious in power
english: [[Your right hand, O Lord, is glorified in power; your right hand has shattered the enemy >> Bible:Exodus 15:6]]. The right hand is Christ, the [[arm of the Lord >> Bible:Isaiah 53:1]]. At the cross the hostile powers are broken.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: Who is like you among the gods?
english: [[Who is like you among the gods, O Lord — glorious in the holy ones, doing wonders? >> Bible:Exodus 15:11]]. Not a ranking of peer idols, but the confession that none compares.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: You stretched out your right hand
english: [[You stretched out your right hand, and the earth swallowed them >> Bible:Exodus 15:12]]. The earth that swallows foes is God’s judgment — sometimes the deep itself. The church learns to stretch out hands in the shape of Christ’s cross.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.

title: In your justice you led this people
english: [[In your justice you led this people whom you redeemed >> Bible:Exodus 15:13]]. Not our merits but God’s justice. Redemption comes first; grace opens the road.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Heine FOTC 71.
